name: Open Redirect Verification Cases
rules: Do not classify based on status code alone.
Do not classify based on reflection in the body or Location substring alone.
Parse Location according to browser-compatible URL semantics relative to response URL.
Compare normalized scheme, hostname and effective port against the target origin and explicit allowlist.
Do not automatically follow redirects in the first request; collect each hop under controlled conditions.
Only use a tester-controlled marker host and IP.

cases.reason: A 3xx with a parsed external Location to the unique controlled marker is strong server-side evidence.
Reflected URL text does not establish navigation.
Resolve the relative Location against the response URL and compare origin.
Marker in path/query/fragment is not the URL hostname.
The marker appears in userinfo; parsed host is still the allowed host.
The parsed host is the controlled marker host.
Capture each hop and final destination; preserve first-hop evidence.
Requires browser verification; not a server-side Location redirect.
Do not merge with ordinary HTTP(S) Open Redirect.
Classify as header injection/response splitting candidate, not normal Open Redirect.
